h: Shabbos and Honoring Parents After Spiritual Failure

p: In this parsha, in the second Dibros,
it is written in the utterance of Shabbos,
and likewise in the utterance of honoring father and mother:
כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (דְּבָרִים ה, יב, טז)
"as He commanded you" is not written.
for it is written 'as Hashem your God commanded you,'
as He commanded you at Marah."
when there it is not explicitly mentioned
that they were commanded about Shabbos and honoring parents,
according to the exposition of the Mechilta
and regarding Shabbos it would have been more fitting
where resting on Shabbos is mentioned.
But why does it need to say at all,
Also, why in the first Dibros
was "as He commanded you" not mentioned
that at Marah, since there was concealed from them
the light that they had had
at the splitting of the Sea
as is written in the holy Zohar
for the Holy One, blessed is He, is called Torah,
וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
and Torah means only the Holy One, blessed is He
their souls were grieved within them:
lest it again be concealed from them?
that He would afterward give them
the mitzvos of Shabbos and honoring parents;
that He gave them only the passages,
and not that they were commanded
about the mitzvos of Shabbos and honoring parents.
in the language of command and utterance
"He set for them a statute and a law";
that is, to give them this good news,
and this was a consolation for them;
that they would be commanded about Shabbos,
that is, that the words of Torah
will be engraved — yuchkeku — in their hearts,
and the light will not be concealed from them again;
And although it is a matter
and the nations of the world too
who hold this world to be the main thing;
who brought him into the world,
so that he can fulfill for himself
every desire and delight of this world.
This is not so for Yisrael;
for in truth they voted and concluded
that it would have been better for a man
not to have been created, etc.
only one's rebbe should be honored,
who brings him to the life of Olam HaBa.
as is written in the Tikkunim
Rather, he was from the inner side;
and that one from the soul."
who comprises all the words of Torah,
is the root of the souls of all Yisrael;
"Your word is a lamp to my feet,"
נֵר ה׳ נִשְׁמַת אָדָם (מִשְׁלֵי כ, כז)
and "the lamp of Hashem is the soul of man" (Mishlei 20:27);
and as is written in the holy sefarim
that the six hundred thousand letters in the Torah
correspond to the six hundred thousand souls.
the holiness of all the bodies of Yisrael;
for all the bodies of Yisrael
since there was no unworthy one in his offspring.
and whoever is of the seed of Yisrael,
"none of them will be cast away,"
the mitzvah of honoring father and mother,
for from them is the body,
which also has holiness in it.
And this is why there was given them at Marah
the mitzvos of Shabbos and honoring parents:
He informed them of these passages,
that they would afterward be commanded about them;
so that they would not be pained
lest, chas v'shalom, they corrupt again;

p: as it says in the Midrash
Torah learning was implanted in their hearts, etc.;
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts"
therefore there was no need there
This is not so in the second Dibros,
lest, chas v'shalom, the yetzer hara overpower them
and this is in the holiness of the soul.
which indicates the body of Yisrael,
that they will not be entirely corrupted, chas v'shalom
everyone who is of the seed of Yaakov.
they are commanded to honor father and mother,
who brought the holiness into the body.
in the second it is written,
"and so that it may be well with you,"
and in the first it is not written;
and they already asked about this
"It is a tree of life," etc.;
'For I give you good teaching,' etc."
"The Torah of Your mouth is good for me," etc.
Torah she'b'al peh is included in the right,
which is from the side of good,
"Who is the man who desires life,
who loves days, to see good?"
in which there is no good.

p: there was no need to say
"and so that it may be well with you,"
"so that your days may be lengthened,"
consequently it is the good as well,
from the side of the Tree of Life.
This is not so in the second Dibros,
when Torah she'b'al peh became necessary,
there is from the side of the Tree of Knowledge
"so that your days may be lengthened
and so that it may be well with you"
at the end of the passage there (Devarim 30:19):
the good is truly included in it;
And so it is written in this parsha,
in the answer to the wise son's question
"to keep us alive, as on this day"
it too mentioned life and good.
"for our good, to keep us alive."
it mentioned the Exodus from Mitzrayim;
and for this the mitzvos came,
which are counsels for fearing Hashem;
and fear is the attribute of Malchus,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
that is, to merit Torah she'b'al peh
in accordance with the order of the unfolding of the attributes
And it says, "to keep us alive, as on this day":
the day of the giving of the Torah,
as on the day it was given from Har Sinai
they came to the wilderness of Sinai" (Shemos 19:1)
as if pointing with a finger.
And this is "to keep us alive, as on this day":
as on the day of the giving of the Torah,
which was only life of goodness.

rich.text: “שבעת ימים תאכל מצת וביום השביעי חג ליהוה”
— ““Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a festival of יהוה.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Devarim 5:16 — “כבד את אביך ואת אמך כאשר צוך יהוה אלהיך למען  יאריכן ימיך ולמען ייטב לך על האדמה אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך” — “Honor your father and your mother, as the ETERNAL your God has commanded you, that you may long endure, and that you may fare well, in the land that the ETERNAL your God is assigning to you.”

rich.text: “כבד את אביך ואת אמך כאשר צוך יהוה אלהיך למען  יאריכן ימיך ולמען ייטב לך על האדמה אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך”
— “Honor your father and your mother, as the ETERNAL your God has commanded you, that you may long endure, and that you may fare well, in the land that the ETERNAL your God is assigning to you.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 30:19 — “העדתי בכם היום את השמים ואת הארץ החיים והמות נתתי לפניך הברכה והקללה ובחרת בחיים למען תחיה אתה וזרעך” — “I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day: I have put before you life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life—if you and your offspring would live—”

rich.text: “העדתי בכם היום את השמים ואת הארץ החיים והמות נתתי לפניך הברכה והקללה ובחרת בחיים למען תחיה אתה וזרעך”
— “I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day: I have put before you life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life—if you and your offspring would live—”

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 6:24 — “ויצונו יהוה לעשות את כל החקים האלה ליראה את יהוה אלהינו לטוב לנו כל הימים לחיתנו כהיום הזה” — “Then the ETERNAL commanded us to observe all these laws, to revere the ETERNAL our God, for our lasting good and for our survival, as is now the case.”

rich.text: “ויצונו יהוה לעשות את כל החקים האלה ליראה את יהוה אלהינו לטוב לנו כל הימים לחיתנו כהיום הזה”
— “Then the ETERNAL commanded us to observe all these laws, to revere the ETERNAL our God, for our lasting good and for our survival, as is now the case.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Malachi 1:6 — “בן יכבד אב ועבד אדניו ואם אב אני איה כבודי ואם אדונים אני איה מוראי אמר  יהוה צבאות לכם הכהנים בוזי שמי ואמרתם במה בזינו את שמך” — “A son should honor his father, and a slave his master. Now if I were a father, where would be the honor due Me? And if I were a …”

rich.text: “בן יכבד אב ועבד אדניו ואם אב אני איה כבודי ואם אדונים אני איה מוראי אמר  יהוה צבאות לכם הכהנים בוזי שמי ואמרתם במה בזינו את שמך”
— “A son should honor his father, and a slave his master. Now if I were a father, where would be the honor due Me? And if I were a …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 19:1 — “בחדש השלישי לצאת בני ישראל מארץ מצרים ביום הזה באו מדבר סיני” — “On the third new moon after the Israelites had gone forth from the land of Egypt, on that very day, they entered the wilderness of Sinai.”

rich.text: “בחדש השלישי לצאת בני ישראל מארץ מצרים ביום הזה באו מדבר סיני”
— “On the third new moon after the Israelites had gone forth from the land of Egypt, on that very day, they entered the wilderness of Sinai.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 26:16 — “היום הזה יהוה אלהיך מצוך לעשות את החקים האלה ואת המשפטים ושמרת ועשית אותם בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך” — “The ETERNAL your God commands you this day to observe these laws and rules; observe them faithfully with all your heart and soul.”

rich.text: “היום הזה יהוה אלהיך מצוך לעשות את החקים האלה ואת המשפטים ושמרת ועשית אותם בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך”
— “The ETERNAL your God commands you this day to observe these laws and rules; observe them faithfully with all your heart and soul.”
